GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. A free key from https://aistudio.google.com turns on the Gemma 4 chat. Leave empty to run with listings, filters, the map and emergency lines only.

GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Places + Routes key for 'near a place' answers, walking times and nearby hotels.

GOOGLE_MAPS_BROWSER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Maps JavaScript key (restrict it to your site's address). Without it the map uses OpenStreetMap.
